changeSet.comment: Update manual charges created in EA-331 to use calculation type "Aval" (286) instead of "Honorarios" (1009).

update.where: charge_calculation_enum = 1009 AND name IN ( 'Cargo Manual Capital', 'Cargo Manual Intereses', 'Cargo Manual Mora', 'Cargo Manual Mipyme', 'Cargo Manual GAC', 'Cargo Manual Seguro', 'Cargo Manual FNG' )

update.where: charge_time_enum = 8 AND name IN ( 'Cargo Manual Capital', 'Cargo Manual Intereses', 'Cargo Manual Mora', 'Cargo Manual Mipyme', 'Cargo Manual GAC', 'Cargo Manual Seguro', 'Cargo Manual FNG' )
